overview: OpenEvidence builds an AI search and decision-support platform for clinicians, grounded in medical evidence.

intelligence.description: OpenEvidence builds an AI search and decision-support platform for clinicians, grounded in medical evidence.
company: OpenEvidence builds an AI platform that helps clinicians find and synthesize medical evidence at the point of care.
It raised a $250 million Series D at a $12 billion valuation in January 2026, doubling the valuation reported at its preceding round.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Clinical AI is a high-stakes category where product quality, evidence partnerships, and workflow adoption matter as much as model capability. OpenEvidence is a key private-market signal for trusted, vertical AI distribution.

changed.text: Announced $250M Series D at a $12B valuation.

takeaways: The latest reported round valued OpenEvidence at $12B.
Its core challenge is converting clinical trust and usage into durable enterprise adoption.
Medical evidence quality and regulatory expectations remain central to the category.
